1#main: The law of a firstborn slaughtered not according to a sage. In it are 3 seifim. One who slaughters the firstborn not according to a sage—even if he showed it to a sage afterward and a blemish was found in it—it is forbidden; and the same applies at this time if he did not show it to three members of the community.
2#main: One who slaughtered the firstborn not according to an expert and sold it and they ate it—he returns the money to them; if they did not eat it, he buries it and returns the money to them.
3#main: One who is not an expert and saw the firstborn and it was slaughtered based on him—he buries it and pays from his house. And how much does he pay? If it is in Eretz Yisrael—for a large animal, half its value; for a small animal, a quarter of its value. And in the Diaspora, whether small or large, half its value. And nowadays, since even in Eretz Yisrael most of Israel's fields are not permitted to raise small livestock—even in Eretz Yisrael, therefore even in Eretz Yisrael for a small animal he pays half the value.
